newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian schoolboy burned in petrol attack.
newsitem.headline: Australian schoolboy burned in petrol attack.

text.p: A six-year-old Australian boy was severely burned on Thursday when a man walked into his schoolyard, doused him with petrol and set him alight, police said.
They said the 26-year-old man then gave himself up to a policeman on traffic duty outside the school in the north Queesnland town of Cairns.
The man was later charged with attempted murder.
A brief police statement suggested no motive for the attack, but the boy's uncle told Australian radio that it appeared to be a random act of violence.
"He'd apparently just gone into the school, chose at random any child, threw the fuel over him and set him alight," he said.
The boy was flown for specialist treatment in Queensland state capital Brisbane after receiving treatment in Cairns. He was reported to have burns on 60 percent of his body.
The school principal was also receiving treatment for burns after helping to rescue the child, police added.
